qualification.details: Qualification: Master's degree from a recognized university Experience: Minimum ten years of experience in the disability sector, of which not less than seven years in autism or cerebral palsy or mental retardation or multiple disabilities; and administrative experience of not less than three years as Chief Executive Officer or Chairperson or President or General Secretary of any NGO serving at least ten years in the areas of autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation or multiple disabilities Age limit: Maximum 62 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications by the Central Government) | Other conditions: | Where the Chairperson is a retired person, salary payable together with pension or pensionary value shall not exceed the basic pay of a Secretary to the Government of India. | Desirable: | Preference to a postgraduate degree in one or more areas of disability or community based disability rehabilitation (autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation, multiple disability) recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India, with RCI registration as personnel or professional Research papers published in reputed professional journals

salary_details.pay_scale: Equivalent to the basic pay of a Secretary to the Government of India

how_to_apply: Apply in the prescribed proforma together with supporting documents to Shri Sultan Singh Meena, Under Secretary to the Government of India, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Room No. 520, 5th Floor, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.
Application must reach within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.
Download the application form from https://depwd.gov.in.
Candidates who applied on the last occasion must apply afresh.
Make sure it reaches by 8 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: DEPwD Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 26-22/2019-DD-III gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DEPwD notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's degree from a recognized university Experience: Minimum ten years of experience in the disability sector, of which not less than seven years in autism or cerebral palsy or mental retardation or multiple disabilities; and administrative experience of not less than three years as Chief Executive Officer or Chairperson or President or General Secretary of any NGO serving at least ten years in the areas of autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation or multiple disabilities Age limit: Maximum 62 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications by the Central Government) Other conditions: Where the Chairperson is a retired person, salary payable together with pension or pensionary value shall not exceed the basic pay of a Secretary to the Government of India. Desirable: Preference to a postgraduate degree in one or more areas of disability or community based disability rehabilitation (autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation, multiple disability) recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India, with RCI registration as personnel or professional Research papers published in reputed professional journals

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DEPwD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications Applications without supporting documents Advance applications not forwarded through proper channel Applications received after the last date

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Salary equals the basic pay of a Secretary to the Government of India; for a retired person, salary together with pension or pensionary value of terminable benefits or both shall not exceed that basic pay. Term of appointment: three years from the date of appointment

content_sections.heading: How Will DEPwD Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Search-cum-Selection Committee; the Committee is free to identify and recommend any other person based on merit, who has not applied for the post Search-cum-Selection Committee may identify and recommend any other person based on merit who has not applied

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed proforma Supporting documents; the number of documents enclosed is to be stated in the proforma

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates who applied for the post last time must apply afresh More details on the website of National Trust: https://nationaltrust.nic.in/

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DEPwD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for DEPwD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form may be downloaded from https://depwd.gov.in; proforma printed on pages 3-4 of the circular) and send it to Shri Sultan Singh Meena, Under Secretary to the Government of India, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Room No. 520, 5th Floor, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, by post, to reach by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for DEPwD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 62 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications by the Central Government).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Equivalent to the basic pay of a Secretary to the Government of India.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree from a recognized university; preference for a postgraduate degree, or a postgraduate degree with a diploma or degree, in disability or community based disability rehabilitation recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India. Minimum ten years' experience in the disability sector.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Where the Chairperson is a retired person, salary payable together with pension or pensionary value shall not exceed the basic pay of a Secretary to the Government of India.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications. Applications without supporting documents. Advance applications not forwarded through proper channel. Applications received after the last date.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Search-cum-Selection Committee; the Committee is free to identify and recommend any other person based on merit, who has not applied for the post. Search-cum-Selection Committee may identify and recommend any other person based on merit who has not applied.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Term of appointment: three years from the date of appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: New Delhi.
